tiebreakers.description: Whoever has more pillars in the last round (Age) wins

notes: family: rounds-quest-lanes. Per quest: compare dominant suit to pick the conditional reward, highest power wins the lane (lowest if the 'least power' modifier), pillar holder breaks ties. Renown can be negative. Quest rewards vary by Quest card, so enter net renown per Age. Rulebook v1.00 states no explicit outcome if still tied after the pillar tiebreak.
